external_entities.name: Customer
external_entities.description: People who browse and order socks through the mobile app and receive faxed confirmations.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: Mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: Web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app that stores customer information and passes orders to SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that processes orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.

processes.name: Fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that dials the number stored against an order and faxes a customer confirmation.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
processes.notes: Nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

processes.name: Spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the marketing catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy
processes.notes: It was a stopgap and it is still here.

data_stores.name: User database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether the user database ... [is] encrypted.

data_stores.name: Flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file kept alongside SIMS containing only delivery addresses.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: Nobody here can tell me whether ... the flat file [is] encrypted.

data_stores.name: Spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The marketing catalogue containing prices and product copy, stored on a marketing laptop in the office.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

data_flows.name: Browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: API requests
data_flows.description: The mobile app talks to the web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: Customer records
data_flows.description: The web API keeps customer records in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer name, address, and the card they paid with

data_flows.name: Order
data_flows.description: When an order is placed, the web API hands the order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: Delivery address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it

data_flows.name: Dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: Confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.name: Catalogue updates
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_flows.name: Macro execution
data_flows.description: The spreadsheet provides the catalogue and macros used by the marketing process.

trust_boundaries.name: Customer device
trust_boundaries.description: The customer-controlled device on which the mobile app is used.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

trust_boundaries.name: Sokify
trust_boundaries.description: The Sokify-controlled zone containing the web API, databases, SIMS, and fax gateway.

trust_boundaries.name: Office
trust_boundaries.description: The office zone where the marketing laptop containing the catalogue spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app presents a non-web interface because it is described as a mobile app and the text explicitly says there is no website.
assumptions.basis: The source describes customers using a mobile app and states, 'there is no website.'

assumptions.assumption: SIMS presents a non-web interface because it is described as a stock and inventory system rather than a web application.
assumptions.basis: The source calls SIMS 'our stock and inventory system' and does not describe it as a web application.

assumptions.assumption: The fax gateway presents a non-web interface because it is described as a fax gateway that dials and faxes.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the component as a fax gateway that dials a number and faxes a confirmation.

assumptions.assumption: The spreadsheet macros present a non-web interface because they are macros running in a spreadsheet.
assumptions.basis: The source describes 'macros in' the spreadsheet that send SQL statements.

assumptions.assumption: The user database is confidential because it contains customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the user database contains 'name, address, and the card they paid with.'

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains delivery addresses, which are personal information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses and nothing else.

assumptions.assumption: The customer device is a tenant trust zone because it is controlled by the customer rather than Sokify.
assumptions.basis: The mobile app is used by customers on their own mobile devices; the boundary represents the customer-controlled device.

assumptions.assumption: The customer device is a tenant trust zone because it is controlled by the customer rather than Sokify.
assumptions.basis: The customer is the user of the mobile app on the customer-controlled device.
